name: Dunmere
description: A wary farming village where missing travelers have become everyone's business.

name: The Grey Road Inn
description: A modest roadside inn where survivors, rumors, and silence all gather together.

name: Broken Caravan
description: A fresh incident site where the first signs of the road's wrongness can be read.

name: Old Forest Path
description: A hunter's trail now carrying more traffic than anyone admits.

name: Collapsed Shrine
description: A ruined roadside shrine occupied by dangerous people and touched by something worse.

name: Subterranean Hollow
description: A hidden chamber beneath the shrine where the deeper truth of the Grey Road can finally be confronted.
